property_details.description:
Introducing House Golden Village, located in Carmen, a prime residential area near the city center. This magnificent property boasts a generous lot area, providing ample space for various purposes.
With a spacious floor area of 438 square meters, House Golden Village offers three levels of luxurious living. It features five bedrooms, each thoughtfully designed to offer comfort and privacy. Additionally, there is an extra room that can be utilized as a guest room or home office. The house is equipped with 5.5 modern and well-appointed bathrooms to cater to the needs of its occupants.
